title: Ticwatch Pro as collector gets unpaired
body: Using ticwatch pro with latest updates and latest nightly release of xdrip when configured to work as collector the first time it connects to dexcom G6 it asks for pairing , I accept , it gets data, all fine, but after 5 minutes when it tries to connect again it gets Unpaired and no  data received.

comments.body: I also just setup a new Ticwatch Pro and am also experiencing the same issue of it repeatedly disconnecting and asking to pair again.

Having the exact issue but with my Fossil gen 4 smart watch. It connects fine the first time and I get a reading on my G5. After that it never gets a reading again with the same error message as above.
Didn't tried with an older version like smth. from feb. march 2018 because I use dexcom G6.
I have the same issue with my new Ticwatch Pro. Works great with the mobile as collector but not with the watch as standalone.  Would be great if somebody has a solution and could share it here.
Keeping an eye on this thread. I have a TicWatch Pro, and waiting on delivery of my Dexcom G6. REALLY want to use a watch as a standalone collector.

I have the same problem with the Ticwatch Pro and MiaoMiao.  Have just updated xDrip on the watch and now it won't act as collector.  Keen to resolve this as I really need to use it as standalone, and it was great before the update.  I did have the same problem when I first started with the MiaoMiao, but it seemed to sort itself out after a while and it was great!  If anyone has a solution I'd be very grateful.

Same problem here with xDrip+, Dexcom G6 and a Ticwatch Pro with "Force Wear Collection Service" enabled. Before Dexcom I was using FreeStyle Libre sensors with BlueReader and later with Miao Miao and both combinations worked very well with the watch as collector (that was in December and January).

But with a G6 and the Ticwatch it seems to work only for one reading: the watch asks to pair with the Dexcom transmitter, displays the new glucose value but then doesn't update any more. Ten or so minutes later it shows the "signal missed" indication (glucose value with strikethrough, i.e. ~120~) and no new readings are displayed. Sometimes I can force a new reading by restarting the collector service on the watch upon which it asks me again to pair with the Dexcom transmitter, but then the cycle continues as described.
@antaflos Hi, quick question, can you upload values in Nightscout when using the watch as a collector? I am very much interested in that even though I made my FINOW work pretty good as we speak...
I've gave up on ticwatch , sent it back.
And which watch do you use now? Can anyone provide a recommendation for an android watch which works as collector with the G6?

Unless anyone can propose a change to the xDrip code that can address this, I would like to close this issue.
We can still add comments to it if a work-around is ever found.
And we can also reopen it if it turns out that we can resolve it by an edit to the code.
Please update accordingly when needed.
